author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
It's finally here. We test and review Valve's Steam Machine, a compact gaming PC that feels right at home in the living room connected to a big screen television. Here's how SteamOS and a variety of games run on the custom hardware designed for Steam Machine, which in many ways is more console than computer. Along with performance, pricing and the pre-order details are also revealed!

Steam Machine: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steammachine
Steam Controller: https://store.steampowered.com/hardware/steamcontroller
Companion Cube: https://dbrand.com/shop/limited-edition/companion-cube
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
